BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM – THEFT DETERRENT AND DOOR LOCK CONTROL SYSTEM

Door Lock Control Switch Circuit

CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION

When the door lock control switch is pushed to the lock side, Lock terminal of the switch is grounded, and when the switch is pushed to the unlock side, Unlock terminal is grounded (See wiring diagram below).
